target_suffix_format: one token A or B after Qwen assistant generation prefix; same user question per pair

examples.question: Which physical quantity is measured in newtons? A. Force B. Energy. Respond using exactly one letter: A or B.
In basic chemistry, oxidation of an atom means what? A. Gaining electrons B. Losing electrons. Respond using exactly one letter: A or B.
What is 7 plus 8? A. 15 B. 16. Respond using exactly one letter: A or B.
Which angle is complementary to 30 degrees? A. 30 degrees B. 60 degrees. Respond using exactly one letter: A or B.
What is the capital of Japan? A. Tokyo B. Osaka. Respond using exactly one letter: A or B.
At standard atmospheric pressure, pure water boils at approximately which Celsius temperature? A. 80 B. 100. Respond using exactly one letter: A or B.
All roses are flowers, and some flowers are yellow. Does it necessarily follow that all roses are yellow? A. Yes B. No. Respond using exactly one letter: A or B.
Which word means the opposite of scarce? A. Abundant B. Hidden. Respond using exactly one letter: A or B.
